Hi Elena / Acme team,

Thanks for agreeing to start the GCP Marketplace onboarding conversation. A couple of quick items I want to confirm so we can move procurement and listing work in parallel: 

- Which partner account will own the listing in the GCP Partner Portal? (we need the exact partner ID to complete the onboarding form)
- Procurement: who should we send the DocuSign / purchase order to for the initial committed capacity?
- Billing model: are you expecting SaaS billing via Marketplace (usage-based invoices) or a committed-reserved monthly invoice?

I attached a short checklist that outlines the docs GCP typically needs (SOC 2, network diagram, product SKU mapping, billing contact). If you can confirm the partner account and procurement contact this week, we’ll: 1) upload the public listing draft to the portal, 2) open the billing SKU table, and 3) get the DocuSign ready.

Attachments: gcp_onboarding_checklist.pdf (checklist, required docs)

Next steps: If Acme procurement is OK with Marketplace SaaS billing, we’ll propose a 12-month committed minimum with monthly invoicing; if they prefer an annual PO, we’ll switch to the reserved plan flow and include the PO number on the DocuSign.

Thanks,
